headline: KEPCO's own notices say a cyber intrusion caused the leak; police were asked to investigate.
summary: Found KEPCO's own apology and KEPCO ON leak notice (Tier 1) on kepco.co.kr. They state a cyber intrusion and outside illegal access attempts, list the leaked KEPCO ON items, and say police were asked to investigate, settling an earlier conflict. c001, c003, c005, c006 and c011 move from Reported to Confirmed; c007 updated; c012 added (Aju Press: registration and card numbers stored encrypted, Reported). 6 new sources (2 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2). The main answer stays Reported pending editor review. Privacy check done.
author: Research agent

headline: KEPCO says an outside attacker took data on about 1.52 million users; claims are Reported, cause not established.
summary: First draft. 7 sources (all Tier 2), 11 claims, 5 questions. KEPCO says an outside attacker took data on about 1.52 million users from KEPCO ON and the SRM procurement system. All of it is Reported, since we read only outlets relaying the company's statement. The method, attacker and any link to the October breach are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
